verdict.rationale: Letta's own MemFS docs say keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search are available by installing the MemFS Search mod. That gives developers some choice of retrieval mode beyond a single fixed similarity search, but only through an add-on mod with few documented details. missing for 10: metadata filters, reranking, documentation of how to configure or steer search modes, built-in (non-mod) support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search
